diagnosis: Disclosure locator uses More in its accessible name, then tries to resolve that same locator after clicking changes the name to Less. Snapshot confirms expanded source content. Keep the focus/expanded assertions using a name that matches both states.

Exact getByLabel Distances includes the nested options in the wrapping label text (DistanceskmmiAU). Browser probe confirms zero matches but an accessible combobox named Distances. Use the role and exact accessible name.

All three mobile Space activations are a real shortcut defect. Browser event probe confirms document shortcut prevents the default Space key and toggles playback despite the sheet synthetic stopPropagation. Guard native shortcuts from object-card targets and preserve native button Space activation. Enter works. Keep all mobile activation, paused-clock, focus and scroll assertions.
next: Fix native shortcut target guard and the two locator assumptions; run card cases before full 53-case production regression. No acceptance until every required assertion and capture is reviewed.
